title: Align to train statistics
description: Realign a shifted / broken numeric column onto train's distribution.

title: Bin column
description: Bin a numeric column by explicit edges or train quantiles.

title: Cast column types
description: Cast columns to the given dtypes; a failing conversion raises.

title: Clip outliers
description: Clip columns to percentile bounds learned on train (state: bounds).

title: Cyclical encoding
description: Encode a cyclic column as '<col>_sin' and '<col>_cos'.

title: Datetime parts
description: Extract hour / dayofweek / month / year / is_weekend from a datetime column.

title: Derive column
description: Add a column combining two columns (ratio, difference, product, days_between).

title: Drop columns
description: Remove the listed columns.

title: Drop correlated
description: Drop one column of each highly correlated pair (keeps the more target-correlated).

title: Drop duplicates
description: Drop duplicate rows, keeping first/last by an explicit sort order.

title: Drop high-missing columns
description: Drop columns whose train missing fraction exceeded the threshold

title: Drop low variance
description: Drop numeric columns whose train variance is at or below a threshold.

title: Drop rows with missing target
description: Drop rows whose target is missing (state: rows dropped at fit).

title: Forward fill
description: Carry the last seen value forward in sort_by order (never backward).

title: Filter rows
description: Keep the rows matching the conditions (no free-form expressions).

title: Formula
description: Add a float column from a whitelisted expression over columns, numbers, functions and train-fitted @variables.

title: Group aggregate
description: Join per-group statistics (fitted on train) onto each row.

title: Impute
description: Fill missing values with a statistic learned on train (median, mean, mode, constant).

title: Impute (iterative)
description: Fill numeric columns by regressing each one on the others (MICE-style).

title: Impute (KNN)
description: Fill numeric columns from the k nearest train rows (scale features first).

title: Interactions
description: Add pairwise products '<a>*<b>' of the listed columns.

title: Log(1 + x)
description: Replace x by log(1 + x) to tame a right skew (refuses negative values).

title: One-hot encode
description: One 0/1 column per train category, in place of the column.

title: Ordinal encode
description: Code each category by its rank in an explicit order (unknown -> -1).

title: Parse dates
description: Parse columns to datetime; unparseable values raise, never become NaT.

title: PCA
description: Replace numeric columns by their principal components pc1..pcN (fitted on train).

title: Rename columns
description: Rename columns via an old -> new mapping.

title: Replace sentinels with NaN
description: Turn sentinel values (-999, 'N/A', ...) into NaN, per column.

title: Scale
description: Rescale numeric columns with train statistics (standard, minmax, robust, maxabs).

title: Select from model
description: Embedded: keep the columns an L1 model or a random forest finds important.

title: Select k best
description: Filter: keep the k best columns by mutual information or F-test with the target.

title: Standardize text
description: Strip / lowercase text columns and map variants to canonical values.

title: Parse numeric text
description: Parse text numbers (currency symbols, thousands / decimal separators,
